title: The ferry ledger
shots: A ferry timetable arrives through an MCP server. Computer reads fifty thousand rows and writes a SQLite database.
The shell returns the route totals in just one hundred and forty-six bytes of text. A separate read brings back this chart.

title: Windows over Venice
shots: Over Venice, four byte-range requests bring three windows of a satellite image into Computer.
An independent reader matches every pixel. The full image is over a hundred megabytes.

title: A designer’s palette
credit: Swift MCP client · Native macOS color list
shots: A Swift client uses Computer to turn the same satellite pixels into six colors a designer can keep.
The palette opens in native Mac software, and the colors also export to Adobe, GIMP, and CSS.

title: Oslofjord in relief
shots: Near Oslo, Computer turns elevation samples into two solid terrain models.
A separate slicer checks both. The taller relief takes eighty-four layers of material.

title: Sunday’s fitting
credit: Chrome origin-private files · Upstream wardrobe MCP
shots: The wardrobe has five jackets for seven ushers. The assistant finds three more and saves the count offline.
Back online, Computer reads the browser’s files and fits everyone. One jacket stays on the rack.

title: Last Boat Home
credit: Original score · Computer WASI command · Verovio
shots: Two Computer shells turn one tune into flute and clarinet parts. Their written pitches differ, but their sounding notes agree.
